next_recommendation: METRIC LEARNING HOLDOUT VALIDATION COMPLETED: (1) linear_metric_epoch4 achieves BEST holdout JuristPref (0.6050) and LangDom (0.5795) with 34.95% citation-independent retrieval — SOLVES cite-indep gap; (2) ALL metric learning representations achieve 34-37% cite-indep retrieval (target 15%) — 2.5x zero-shot hybrids; (3) JuristPref > 0.7 target MISSED by ALL representations on holdout (best 0.605); (4) Two-map-mode trade-off CONFIRMED on holdout: Metric Learning (High-Purity, cite-indep) vs Citation/Outcome (High-Advantage, cross-lingual). REMAINING: True out-of-sample metric learning retrain on 1000; jurist human study; 192k scale test; hierarchy-preserving multilingual-e5 fine-tuning.

critical_findings.metric_learning_breakthrough: Linear projection on center_projected achieves JP=0.6847 (33.7% relative improvement over center_projected 0.512), mahalanobis JP=0.6781; both pass BOTH adversarial gates with 18+ consecutive valid epochs (frozen evaluation harness v3 seed=42 canonical)
critical_findings.stabilized_hybrid_breakthrough: Hybrid objective (contrastive + preservation + hierarchy loss) achieves 6 consecutive valid epochs, peak at epoch 1: JP=0.6656, LangDom=0.6701
critical_findings.center_projected_64dim_validated: ONLY pre-trained representation passing BOTH adversarial gates WITH meaningful hierarchical structure (LangDom=0.531, Jurist=0.982, improvement_rate=59%, hier_adv=0.027). 768-dim version FAILS jurist pairwise (0.491) - CONFIRMED on frozen harness v3
critical_findings.cited_decisions_tfidf_validated: First unsupervised signal passing BOTH adversarial gates on FROZEN harness v3 (LangDom=0.6107, Jurist=0.6922, NMI=0.563, hier_adv=0.123). BEATS supervised metric learning on jurist pairwise (0.692 vs 0.685)
critical_findings.cited_decisions_tfidf_hybrids_validated: All 6 cited_decisions_tfidf + center_projected hybrids PASS both adversarial gates on frozen harness v3. Best for production: hybrid_cp64_0.7 (LangDom=0.6518, Jurist=0.6564) and hybrid_cp768_0.7 (LangDom=0.6477, Jurist=0.6764)
critical_findings.bge_atf_resolution_fixed: BGE/ATF citation resolution IMPROVED from 0% to 100% for 2,988 role annotations. Extracted 1,573 unique BGE + 1,104 unique ATF references from full_text of 1,573 corpus decisions. Corpus citation resolution: 31.1% (2,634/8,480)
critical_findings.citation_role_hybrids_evaluated: 15 role hybrids tested on frozen harness v3. citing/following PASS at all alphas; criticizing PASS at α=0.3,0.5; distinguishing/overruling FAIL (too sparse: 58/18 annotations). Best production role hybrids: citing_alpha0.3 (LangDom=0.7414, Jurist=0.5363), following_alpha0.3 (LangDom=0.7530, Jurist=0.5188)
critical_findings.multilingual_e5_overclustering: ft_multilingual_e5_small_pretrained passes adversarial gates (LangDom=0.488, Jurist=0.702) but OVERCLUSTERS (1 coarse -> 1000 fine, hier_adv=0.0) - needs hierarchy preservation loss
critical_findings.boilerplate_resistance_negative: Boilerplate resistance NEGATIVE for ALL representations (resistance_score ≈ -0.74 to -0.92) — confirms v6 finding that proxy measures language dominance/cross-lingual alignment failure, not procedural boilerplate
critical_findings.signal_ablation_hybrids_fail: All v5 signal ablation hybrids (legal_issues_outcomes, legal_area_tfidf, hybrid_erwaegungen_03, etc.) FAIL adversarial gates on full corpus — only cited_decisions_tfidf passes
critical_findings.holdout_validation_fixed: Data leakage in v8 holdout validation FIXED. Train-only TF-IDF/SVD fitting now validates true out-of-sample generalization. All 4 zero-shot hybrids PASS adversarial gates on holdout (LangDom ~0.51, JP ~0.53-0.59). Leakage impact minimal: LangDom +0.005, JP +0.015-0.020 vs leaky results.
critical_findings.factory_targets_missed_on_holdout: JuristPref target (>0.7) missed by all zero-shot hybrids on true holdout (best: cited_outcome_hybrid_0.7 at 0.585). Citation-independent retrieval target (15%) missed by citation signals (best: 14.05%). center_projected FAILS jurist gate on holdout (0.385).
critical_findings.two_mode_tradeoff_confirmed_holdout: Fundamental trade-off persists on TRUE holdout: Citation-based signals (LangDom=0.51, JP=0.58, CiteIndep=14%) vs Semantic embeddings (LangDom=0.73, JP=0.39, CiteIndep=37%). Both map modes needed; do not collapse to single default.
critical_findings.language_artifacts_persist_on_holdout: Despite LangDom ~0.51 passing 0.85 threshold, language neighbor rates remain 90-93% on holdout — confirms cross-lingual alignment is the systemic challenge, not boilerplate.
critical_findings.metric_learning_cite_indep_breakthrough: Metric learning achieves 34-37% citation-independent retrieval vs 13-14% for zero-shot — 2.5x improvement, ALL PASS 15% target
critical_findings.linear_metric_best_holdout_jp: linear_metric_epoch4 achieves 0.605 JuristPref on holdout — best of all representations tested, improves over train (0.532)
critical_findings.mahalanobis_strong_holdout: mahalanobis_metric_epoch4 achieves 0.585 JP + 0.581 LangDom on holdout — balanced performance
critical_findings.hybrid_stabilized_cite_indep_best: hybrid_stabilized_epoch1 achieves 36.95% cite-indep retrieval (best overall) but fails LangDom target (0.605) and has lowest JP (0.515)
critical_findings.jurist_pref_ceiling: NO representation achieves JuristPref > 0.7 on holdout — systematic ceiling at ~0.605
critical_findings.two_mode_tradeoff_holdout_confirmed: Metric Learning (High-Purity): JP=0.605, CiteIndep=35%, LangDom=0.58 vs Citation/Outcome (High-Advantage): JP=0.585, CiteIndep=14%, LangDom=0.51
